title: AI coding tools for solo founders
summary: Select a sustainable development workflow around your constraints.

sections.heading: Three constraints before a shortlist
paragraphs: Write down your existing editor, the repository task and a spending limit. Decide whether provider choice is essential or simply interesting. If you cannot explain how you will verify a change, improve the project tests before paying for more autonomy.

sections.heading: Conditional shortlist
paragraphs: Evaluate Cursor for editor-centered iteration, Claude Code for a command-based task loop, Copilot for an existing GitHub workflow and Cline for provider configuration. These are editorial trial directions based on the profiles below, not benchmark results.

sections.heading: A one-week decision log
paragraphs: For each trial, record accepted changes, rejected changes, review effort and observed cost in your own environment. Select the tool that improves the whole loop rather than only the generation step. Stop if it requires weakening safety checks.

verdict: Start with the workflow you can review and maintain alone. Prefer a small trial over a blanket winner.
bestFor: Solo developers maintaining an existing repository
notFor: Teams with unresolved mandatory data, security or deployment requirements
migration: Trial the candidate on a branch; retain the original workflow until tests, export and billing checks pass.

pros.text: Cursor documents an editor and coding-agent workflow for founders who want to inspect repository changes in the editing surface.
Claude Code documents several working surfaces and usage tracking, allowing a founder to evaluate a command loop without assuming a fixed workload cost.

cons.text: Copilot MCP availability can depend on VS Code version and Business or Enterprise organization policy; confirm personal versus managed account entitlements.
Cline documents provider sign-in and bring-your-own-key paths, which leave model/provider selection and its terms as a separate decision.

faqs.question: Does GitHub’s MCP organization policy govern an individual Copilot plan?
faqs.answer: GitHub says the policy applies to organization or enterprise users on Business or Enterprise, not individual Free, Pro, Pro+ or Max plans.

faqs.question: Can a posted plan amount predict solo-founder coding cost?
faqs.answer: Not by itself. Claude Code documents token-based API billing and usage that varies by model and work pattern; Cursor documents included model usage followed by optional on-demand billing.
